targetable_features.rationale: User-identified targetable feature. RNA expression alone is insufficient for DLL3-directed therapy eligibility; protein-level confirmation by IHC (e.g. SP347 antibody) is the gating biomarker for current DLL3-directed clinical trials and approved indications.

User-identified targetable feature. PRAME-targeting therapies fall into two mechanism classes: (a) HLA-A*02:01-restricted ImmTACs (PRAME × CD3 bispecifics, e.g. brenetafusp) and TCR-T (e.g. IMA203) which require both PRAME protein expression AND HLA-A*02:01 positivity; (b) PRAME-directed mRNA vaccines (e.g. mRNA-4203) which are HLA-agnostic. RNA expression alone is insufficient for the HLA-restricted programs — a positive PRAME IHC plus HLA-A*02:01 typing is the gating biomarker pair.
